designSystem: SEED Design (당근 디자인 시스템) — rootage tokens + component specs
thesis: White layers on a grey basement, 16px gutters, bold short labels, and one carrot-orange solid action. layout.css holds values in the same layers as linear / toss — SEED palette (palette-*) → SEED roles (fg-* / bg-* / stroke-*, kept under SEED's own names) → shadcn slots → component geometry (control-*, field-*, chip-*, list-row-* …) → type scale t1 … t14 and roles. Every value is a rootage token, not a pixel measurement.
applyOnto: mobile-first product screens (390 wide, max content 480); desktop as a centred column or a 16px-gutter list
doNotCopy: the carrot / 당근 logo, Daangn brand marks, and the SEED icon set (@karrotmarket/react-monochrome-icon) — use the product's own icons
manner-temp and banner tints outside a Daangn-like marketplace; they are domain tokens, not general status colours
seed-design docs site chrome (Next.js docs shell) — never captured, not part of the theme
--gradient-highlight-magic for ordinary actions; SEED keeps it for AI (magic) features only

color.palette: --palette-gray-00 … --palette-gray-1000, carrot / blue / red / green / yellow / purple 100 … 1000 (redefined under .dark), --palette-static-black / --palette-static-white and their alpha steps (fixed)
color.note: SEED ships theme-light and theme-dark as first-class modes. Roles are palette var() references redeclared in .dark (some roles also change step there, e.g. --fg-brand carrot-600 → 700), so components never branch on scheme.

status.contrast: every tone has an fg-{tone}-contrast role for text on its weak fill

shadcn.note: --background is --bg-layer-basement (grey, black in dark) and --card is --bg-layer-default (white, gray-100 in dark). A single white screen puts its content on --card or bg-bg-layer-default; equal values would fail validate-layout-scheme.

darkMode.source: rootage color.yaml theme-dark values; nothing derived

type.scale: --text-t1 … --text-t14 (11 → 48px, rem so it follows font scaling; SEED clamps 0.8 … 1.5x)
type.note: SEED has no semibold: text is 400, labels 500, titles and every button / tab label 700. There is no letter-spacing token; keep 0.

button.pressed: fill steps to the *-pressed role and the button scales to --scale-s97 over --duration-pressed-scale / --ease-pressed-scale
button.shadcnMap: default → brandSolid, secondary → neutralWeak, outline → neutralOutline, ghost → ghost, destructive → criticalSolid; data-size xs / sm / default / lg → xsmall / small / medium / large

field.note: Outline fields have no well; focus thickens the stroke to 2px neutral-contrast (black), not a blue ring.

badge.tones: weak = bg-{tone}-weak + fg-{tone}-contrast, solid = bg-{tone}-solid + static white, outline = stroke-{tone}-weak + fg-{tone}

notLinear.edges: Layers separate by fill (basement grey under white screens), 1px --stroke-neutral-muted hairlines between rows. Cards carry no shadow and no border.
notLinear.elevation: Only floating layers (menu, popover, snackbar) take --shadow-s1 … s3.
notLinear.primaryAction: One --bg-brand-solid (carrot) button per screen, often large (52h, r12) and full-width at the bottom; secondary actions are neutral-weak grey, not outline.
notLinear.density: Mobile density: 40px controls, 16px body text, 12px row padding. No 28-32px desktop rows.
notLinear.radius: Radius grows with the control (8 → 12), chips / segmented / switch are pills, overlays are 20-24.
notLinear.focus: Fields focus by a 2px black (neutral-contrast) stroke; the blue --stroke-focus-ring is for keyboard focus only.
notLinear.font: System stack led by -apple-system / Apple SD Gothic Neo → Pretendard; weights 400 / 500 / 700 only.
notLinear.copy: Korean 해요체, short verbs on buttons (예: 확인, 채팅하기).

shell.model: mobile screen: --top-nav-height app bar, --spacing-global-gutter inset content, bottom CTA; on desktop centre a --content-narrow column

checklist: Screen on --bg-layer-default; grouped sections sit on --bg-layer-basement
Every colour through a SEED role (fg / bg / stroke) so .dark works; palette only when a component spec names a step
